largest_evidenced_gap: The new operation result is not a complete content-addressed before-and-after observation. It contains only caller-selected post-operation component rows, permits a swap target with no parent, does not require observed component transaction or valid-from time to be no later than observed_at, and omits both receipt digests from basis_sha256 and result_id. The root projection then checks only that every supplied result row occurs in the root component list, not that the two lists are equal. These are one cause: the accepted result basis is not the exhaustive causal operation observation claimed by the source receipt.

decisive_source.finding: operationResultBasis omits verification_receipt_sha256 and operation_receipt_sha256 even though result_id and basis_sha256 derive from it.
Swap requires parent deactivation only when target.parent_component_id is non-null; replay has no before/after component comparison.
observed_at is compared with plan.requested_at, not with component transaction_time or valid_from.
The root validates every result row against the root but never requires exhaustive equality.
The public schema mirrors the incomplete one-sided observation and digest fields, so it cannot express before-row equality or causal component-time joins.

required_repair: Project descriptor-closed before_components and after_components, or exact before and after component-snapshot digest refs, and require the operation result to equal the intended root snapshot rather than a caller-selected subset.

Define parentless swap semantics explicitly. If swap means replacement, require a same-logical-identity replaced generation and its postcondition for every target; otherwise use a separate insertion operation.
Require every observed component transaction_time, valid_from, and applicable valid_until to be causally compatible with observed_at.

Include verification and operation receipt envelopes in the operation-result basis, derive result_id from the complete immutable body, and reject same-ID receipt-distinct results. Preserve issuer authenticity and action authority as separate false/nonclaim fields.

Freeze these four executed hashes plus root-subset runtime, deployed, and public-revalidation variants as regressions, rebuild the exact 12-file manifest and source receipt, and request a distinct fresh critic.
